| Status | Label | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `wired` | Active | The engine reads this and it changes the run. |
| `partial` | Partly active | The engine reads part of this, or acts on it only under the conditions the field's own note states. |
| `not-implemented` | Not yet implemented | Validated and recorded in the scenario digest, and read by nothing. Editing it does not change the run. |
| `refused` | Only its implemented values load | The loader refuses any value this build cannot act on, so the field is real but its choices are narrower than the schema's. |
| `descriptive` | Description | Describes the scenario: shown in the page and kept in the run's record. By design it changes nothing the run computes. |
| `unknown` | Unclassified | This build does not say whether the engine acts on it. |
